acknowledged.detail: CreateSession is answered 200 <ListBucketResult>, which is what the same path answers with no operation selected: Backlot neither implements it nor refuses it, so a caller parses another operation's body
acknowledged.note: Not a fallthrough Backlot chose: CreateSession exists for directory buckets only, and real S3 answers `GET /{bucket}?session` on a general purpose bucket with the ListBucketResult too, and `?session&versioning` as GetBucketVersioning with no conflict (measured in us-east-1 and ap-northeast-2), so the listing is the faithful answer and `session` is deliberately not a selector Backlot refuses.

acknowledged.detail: GetObjectAcl is refused (501 NotImplemented), which is an honest answer for an operation Backlot does not serve
acknowledged.note: Refused with NotImplemented (501) rather than answered with the object's bytes. Real S3 answers 200 <AccessControlPolicy> with the object owner (measured in us-east-1 and ap-northeast-2 against a general purpose bucket with none of this configured).

acknowledged.detail: GetObjectAnnotation is refused (501 NotImplemented), which is an honest answer for an operation Backlot does not serve
acknowledged.note: Refused with NotImplemented (501) rather than answered with the object's bytes. Real S3 answers 200 <ListObjectAnnotationsOutput> with empty Annotations; the bare `?annotation` the probe sends is the List form (measured in us-east-1 and ap-northeast-2 against a general purpose bucket with none of this configured).
